rationale: EWY is a tokenized Korea ETF, so crypto structure is noise and this is a pure equity read: price is stretched (RSI 77 on 1h, bb_pctb 0.947 at the upper band, ADX 78 = blow-off-prone) with a bearish divergence flag, and it is a laggard (RS -3.47), so the scanner's LONG is chasing an overbought echo into resistance at 202.90. The decisive factor is a hard binary: Samsung Q2 preliminary earnings tomorrow (Jul 7) hit EWY's ~40%-weight holding in the Korean morning while the US cash market is closed, making a fresh long or short a gappy coin-flip rather than a structured setup. No size justifies buying overbought into an unhedgeable two-sided event; the highest-expectancy move is to stand aside and let the event resolve.

reconsider.note: Losing the 174.61 swing support confirms the bearish divergence/exhaustion has resolved down and turns this into a real short (retest of the broken level), rather than fading a still-intact AI-supercycle uptrend blind.
